body.en: Both formal insurance and community savings pools help households recover after a disaster, but they work differently. Sort each description into the one it describes.

items.label: Neighbours each contribute monthly; anyone can draw on it after a shared disaster
A paid policy that pays a fixed amount if your named risk (e.g. flood) happens
Backed by a registered company with legal payout obligations
Relies on trust and rules the group itself agrees on
Slower payout, but flexible with no company approval process needed
Requires regular payments even in years nothing happens
